Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Old Catalan honrar, from Latin honōrāre.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central) [unˈra]
  • IPA(key): (Balearic) [onˈra]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [onˈraɾ]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)
  • Homophone: honrà
  • Rhymes: -a(ɾ)

Verb

[edit]

honrar (first-person singular present honro, first-person singular preterite honrí, past participle honrat); root stress: (Central, Valencia, Balearic) /o/

  1. to honor

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Old Galician-Portuguese onrar, from Latin honorāre.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /õˈʁa(ʁ)/ [õˈha(h)]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /õˈʁa(ʁ)/ [õˈha(h)]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /õˈʁa(ɾ)/ [õˈha(ɾ)]
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /õˈʁa(ʁ)/ [õˈχa(χ)]
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /õˈʁa(ɻ)/ [õˈha(ɻ)]
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /õˈʁaɾ/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /õˈʁaɾ/
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /õˈʁa.ɾi/

  • Audio (Brazil (Caipira)):(file)
  • Hyphenation: hon‧rar

Verb

[edit]

honrar (first-person singular present honro, first-person singular preterite honrei, past participle honrado)

  1. to honor
    Antonym: desonrar

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Old Spanish hondrar, onrrar, onrar, from Latin honōrāre.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /onˈraɾ/ [õnˈraɾ]
  • Audio (Colombia):(file)
  • Rhymes: -aɾ
  • Syllabification: hon‧rar

Verb

[edit]

honrar (first-person singular present honro, first-person singular preterite honré, past participle honrado)

  1. (transitive) to honor
    Antonym: deshonrar
